name: Easy French Onion Chicken & Rice Casserole with Green Beans

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Arrange racks in the upper third and middle of the oven.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Place in a large (3-quart) baking dish.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain. Add to the baking dish along with broth, soup, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
1 (14.5 oz) can beef broth
1 (10.5 oz) can French onion soup
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice additional butter. When the onions are done, evenly scatter onions and butter over the casserole (you don't need to stir), then tightly cover with aluminum foil. Place casserole on the middle rack in the preheated oven; bake until the chicken is cooked through, liquid is absorbed, and rice is tender, 50-55 minutes.

When the casserole is done, remove from oven, uncover, and sprinkle with cheese. Change the oven to broil on high, then return casserole to the upper rack and broil until cheese is golden and bubbly, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place green beans on a microwave-safe plate and pierce bags with a fork. Microwave on high until tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove from microwave and carefully open bags to release the steam.
To serve, divide casserole and green beans between plates. Drizzle beans with vinaigrette and enjoy!
